system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You have transcended the boundary between shinobi and feral beast entirely. The Manic condition is no longer something you suffer from. It’s something you utilize and command. Not only that, but due to your Nature Energy, when you become Manic, you are no longer alone.

Once per turn, at the start of your turn, you can choose to become Manic voluntarily ignoring the Nature Energy requirements. Becoming Manic this way costs 2 Nature Energy at the beginning of each of your turns to maintain. If you cannot pay this cost, the condition ends and you become Dazed and Staggered as the sudden mental whiplash takes time to recover from.

Additionally, when you become Manic, you can spend your Reaction to release a pulse of concentrated Nature Energy outward, saturating the bodies of your allies with raw primal forces. Select up to two willing allied creatures you can see within 30 feet. Each selected ally becomes Manic and treat any creature currently marked as your Priority Target as their Priority Target as well. Both allies occupies one of your concentration slots as if concentrating on an A-Rank jutsu.

Your allies mania ends if you lose concentration on them, the priority targets hit points are reduced to 0, or they are incapacitated.
